v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath inclined * his ear unto me.

text.la: Vota mea * Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo eius.
text.en: I will pay my vows * in the sight of all his people.
I have cried to the Lord, * and he hath heard me.

text.la: Auxílium meum * a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text.en: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

text.la: Lætátus sum * in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi. ‡
text.en: I rejoiced * at the things that were said to me. ‡

text.la: Beátus vir, qui suffert tentatiónem: quóniam cum probátus fúerit, accípiet corónam vitæ, quam repromísit Deus diligéntibus se.
text.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been proved, he shall receive a crown of life, which God hath promised to them that love him.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Qui vult veníre post me, * ábneget semetípsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequátur me.
text.en: If any man will come after me, * let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.

text.la: Infirmitátem nostram réspice, omnípotens Deus: et, quia pondus própriæ actiónis gravat, beáti Ignátii Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis intercéssio gloriósa nos prótegat.
text.en: Mercifully consider our weakness, O Almighty God, and whereas by the burden of our sins we are sore, may the glorious intercession of blessed Ignatius, Your Martyr and Bishop, sustain us.
